contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: Workshops search parts by sending a WhatsApp message from these numbers. Other numbers get a reply asking them to contact you.

list.title: WhatsApp numbers
list.description: Numbers that can search parts on WhatsApp.

empty.manager: Add the WhatsApp number of a workshop so it can search parts by message.
empty.viewer: Owners and admins add the WhatsApp numbers of the workshops.

rename.label: Name of {{name}}
rename.hint: Leave it empty to show the WhatsApp name or the number.

add.title: Add a contact
add.description: The number can search parts on WhatsApp right away. A number can belong to one company only.
add.phoneHint: With the international prefix, for example +39.
add.name: Name
add.nameHint: Optional. Shown instead of the WhatsApp name.

errors.phone: Start with the international prefix, for example +39 333 123 4567.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.body: Messages from this number are ignored until you unblock it, so it cannot search parts. Past searches stay in the history.

remove.title: Delete {{name}}?
remove.body: The contact and its name are deleted and the number can no longer search parts. Past searches stay in the history without the contact. You can add the number again later.

notices.added: {{name}} added. The number can search parts now.
notices.nameCleared: Name removed, the WhatsApp name or the number is shown.
notices.unblocked: {{name}} is unblocked and can search again.
